senses.gloss:
जड जड (probably for original जल, to which the Grammar. give the same signification; Lat. gĕlu gelidus; Goth. kald; A.S. ceald; cf. जत), adj.
 1. Cold, Pañc. i. d. 353.
 2. Rigid, immoveable, Rām. 6, 6, 1.
 3. Material, irrational, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 22.
 4. Dimmed, Śāk. d. 81.
 5. Unfeeling, apathetic, Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 10.
 6. Stupid, Bhāg. P. 5, 9, 8.
 7. Dumb, Man. 2, 110.
 --Comp.

जडता जड + ता, f.
 1. Apathy, [] Sāh. D. 175.
 2. Stupidity, Mārk. P. 10, 33.
जडत्व जड + त्व, n. Stupidity, Rājat. 6, 26.
जडिमन् जडिमन्, i. e. जड + इमन्, m. Stupidity, Rājat. 4, 110.

जाड्य जाड्य, i. e. जड + य, n.
 1. Want of sensation, Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 17.
 2. Stupidity, Bhartṛ. 2, 20.
